TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms its intent to comply with the Ministry of IT & Telecommunication’s mandatory eligibility and technical requirements for establishing and operating a centralized 24x7 SOC and delivering Managed Detection & Response services for three (3) years, extendable on performance.

Eligibility and administrative compliance: We are an SECP-incorporated private limited company with active FBR NTN/ATL status and Punjab & Sindh sales-tax registrations. [CO-PROFILE] We hold valid ISO 27001 certification. [CO-PROFILE] We will furnish bid security of 2% of the bid price in the required form (bank guarantee/CDR) within our available scheduled-bank facility. [CO-PROFILE] We will submit the bid in the required two-envelope format, with one original and two copies, addressed as instructed, and maintain bid validity for 120 days (as per the RFP).

Technical and service compliance (partial areas to be finalized in the Technical Proposal): Our evidence library includes multiple cybersecurity and adjacent infrastructure deliveries for Federal and Provincial Government and private-sector clients. [CAP-012] [CAP-049] [CAP-025] We will design and stand up the SOC with SIEM/SOAR, provide 24x7 tiered monitoring (L1/L2/L3), SLAs, threat intelligence/threat hunting, incident-response runbooks/forensic readiness, periodic vulnerability assessment reporting, and knowledge transfer; detailed tool selection, event-ingestion/retention sizing, and SLA metrics will be finalized and submitted as part of the proposed solution.

Mandatory gaps and closure plan:
- Turnover threshold: Our audited average annual turnover is PKR 900M over the last three audited years, below the PKR 1,200M requirement; our library does not yet evidence compliance, and we will address this via an eligible JV/consortium partner providing the required audited financial statements. [CO-PROFILE]
- Certified SOC tiers: Our library does not yet evidence CISSP/GIAC (or equivalent) coverage across L1/L2/L3; we will meet this requirement through named, certified hires and/or certified subcontract staff prior to mobilization, with certificates submitted in the final staffing plan.
